text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic three-view full-body character turnaround of one adult woman. Warm fair skin, brown-hazel eyes, long smooth dark chestnut hair with soft waves at the ends, center part, straight defined brows, full pink lips. Outfit: Peach-coral spaghetti-strap full-length dress with a twisted ruched V-neck bodice, tasteful small waist-side cutouts, soft hip ruching and a graceful low side slit, nude thin-strap modest-heel sandals. No handbag or sunglasses. Exactly three equal-height figures: strict front, exact 90-degree side profile facing image-right, exact back. Matching facial identity, hairstyle, accessories, clothing construction, garment length and shoes. Coordinated tall 7–8-head model proportions with natural shoulders, waist, hips and long thighs/calves. Neutral upright stance, arms at sides, complete hair and soles in frame, aligned crown and ground baselines. White studio, soft even bright lighting, crisp skin/hair/fabric details, landscape native 1536x1024. No text, watermark, borders or extra figures.
original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Generate a NEW high-detail photographic THREE-VIEW full-body turnaround sheet of the EXACT adult woman and EXACT finished outfit in the supplied latest full-body master. Landscape 1536x1024, pure white seamless background. Exactly three equally sized complete figures in one horizontal row: LEFT strict FRONT looking directly forward; CENTER strict 90-degree SIDE profile facing image-right, head also in profile; RIGHT strict BACK looking away. All three are the same person wearing the same outfit, not different designs. Align anatomical crown heights and shoe soles on identical baselines. Each entire hairstyle and each shoe fully visible, comfortable side margins and no cropping. Match the master's 7–8-head tall coordinated fashion-model proportions, shoulder width, waist, hips, leg length and thickness, natural head size, hairstyle and face. No head-heavy figure, no shortening legs, no overstretched shins. Upright neutral relaxed standing, arms down, empty hands, no posing or tilt, 85mm undistorted camera. Recreate the master's precise neckline, garment shape, lengths, waist position, color, fabric, seams, jewelry, accessories and footwear. Infer unseen back construction conservatively and coherently; no invented extra belts, bows, straps or embellishment. Bright even soft studio illumination in all three views, clear faces, natural skin texture, individual hairs, crisp eyes and fabric detail. Photographic realism, not drawing. No labels, lettering, watermark, border, additional people or detail insets.
Identity description: Warm fair skin, brown-hazel eyes, long smooth dark chestnut hair with soft waves at the ends, center part, straight defined brows, full pink lips.
Outfit description (use visible master as authority if details differ): Peach-coral spaghetti-strap full-length dress with a twisted ruched V-neck bodice, tasteful small waist-side cutouts, soft hip ruching and a graceful low side slit, nude thin-strap modest-heel sandals. No handbag or sunglasses.
